label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
**Sunbelt Charter Coaches — only half the buses showed, no backup, no communication**

I booked Sunbelt Charter Coaches for a client dinner on Thursday, Nov. 5: 220 people, hotel pickup at 6:15 p.m., offsite at a ranch venue in Henderson. We booked four coaches and got written confirmation twice, most recently Tuesday, Nov. 3. Total was $8,400 — 50% deposit in September, balance seven days out. Corey was the dispatcher on everything.

Only two buses showed. The first was 55 minutes late, and the driver told me he got the job at 5 p.m. The second broke down on the 215 — AC dead, people stuck on the shoulder for about 40 minutes. I put 60 people in Ubers and Lyfts on my company card, roughly $1,900. Dinner started at 8:40 instead of 7, and the caterer charged us overtime.

One late bus I could forgive. No backup plan and no communication is not okay. The office line has gone to voicemail since Friday. I’m asking Sunbelt for a refund for the two coaches that never came, plus the rideshare costs.

They were great on two small airport runs last spring, which is why I trusted them with this. Our client is now reviewing whether they keep us for their March event, and that’s on Sunbelt.

Planners, I’d hold off booking them for anything big until they fix dispatch — especially before CES season. I’m sticking to what happened, and I have the confirmations, payment records, and ride receipts, so nobody can say this is exaggerated.
